data.name: Run_DryRunCompleted

data.name: Run_Aborted
data.value: Stopped before any change: the disk layout changed since the plan was made. Plan again.

data.name: CreateSampleNotice
data.value: Sample data: nothing can be applied. On a real disk, run the command below in Terminal (Admin) or open TsuDisk as administrator.

data.name: CreateNeedsAdmin
data.value: Creating a partition needs administrator rights. Reopen TsuDisk as administrator to apply it here, or run the command below in Terminal (Admin).

data.name: CreateApplyNotice
data.value: You can apply this plan here. TsuDisk asks you to type the disk number again, re-checks the disk before every write step, and removes only the new partition if a step fails.

data.name: ConfirmWarningCreate
data.value: This writes to the disk: a new partition is created and formatted in the free space. Existing partitions keep their position, size and data. Windows wipes the start of the free space - if a partition was just deleted there by mistake, cancel and recover it with TestDisk first.

data.name: ConfirmPromptDisk
data.value: Type the disk number {0} to confirm:

data.name: ExtendSampleNotice
data.value: Sample data: nothing can be applied. On a real disk, run the command below in Terminal (Admin) or open TsuDisk as administrator.

data.name: ExtendNeedsAdmin
data.value: Extending a drive needs administrator rights. Reopen TsuDisk as administrator to apply it here, or run the command below in Terminal (Admin).

data.name: ExtendWinReUnknown
data.value: The WinRE status could not be read, so the app does not apply this extend plan. Run the command below in Terminal (Admin) - the CLI reads WinRE again and asks for confirmation.

data.name: ExtendApplyNotice
data.value: You can apply this plan here. TsuDisk asks you to type the drive letter again, re-checks the disk before every write step, and rolls back if a step fails. Extending needs no restart.

data.name: ExtendApplyNoticeRecovery
data.value: You can apply this plan here. The plan moves the Recovery partition (disable WinRE, delete, extend, recreate Recovery, enable WinRE - KB5028997). TsuDisk asks you to type the drive letter again, saves the WinRE image to the log folder, and rolls back if a step fails. Do not shut down while it runs.

data.name: ConfirmWarningExtend
data.value: This writes to the disk: the partition grows into the free space right after it. Its start position and data stay the same; other partitions do not change. Do not shut down or unplug the disk while it runs.

data.name: ConfirmWarningExtendRecovery
data.value: This writes to the disk and DELETES then RECREATES the Recovery partition right after the drive (WinRE is disabled first and enabled again afterwards; the WinRE image is saved to the log folder). Data on the extended drive stays intact. Do not shut down or unplug the disk while it runs.
